texts.en:
To overcome the vast distances that separate £system£ Star Systems, our £scientist£ Scientists have developed the Hyper Drive. This device permits travel at speeds far exceeding that of light between systems connected by hyperlanes.

Travel along a hyperlane is nearly instantaneous, but movement is restricted to the galactic hyperlane network. 

To enter hyperspace, a Ship must first reach the system's edge, beyond the star's gravity well.

This happens automatically when ordering a Ship to move to another System.
